description: Change a page published with publish_page. files [{path, content | url}] add or replace just those files and the rest are kept from the live version; remove [paths] deletes files; html replaces index.html; replace:true publishes exactly the files sent. Each change is a new version with its own preview link; live:false keeps the live page as it is. setLive <version> with no files makes an existing version live: a rollback, or bringing back an unpublished page. abTest {version, split} runs an A/B test: that version for split% of visitors (default 50), the live one for the rest; abTest:false ends it. A site without robots.txt / sitemap.xml gets them generated. get_page file returns a file's current source to edit. Free.

split.description: percent of visitors who see it, 1-99, default 50

version.description: the variant version (publish it with live:false first)

abTest.description: test a version against the live one; false ends the test

badge.description: false takes the Made with Hermoso badge off (paid plans); no files needed

cookieBanner.description: cookie banner + privacy page on or off; no files needed

content.description: the file content: text, or base64 with encoding base64

encoding.description: utf-8 (default) for text, base64 for binary

path.description: relative path inside the site, e.g. index.html, css/site.css, img/hero.webp

url.description: instead of content: the url of a file put through upload_file (or any public https file)

live.description: false = save as a preview only

name.description: the page name, which is its address: spring-sale is served at https://spring-sale.hermoso.page

replace.description: true = the new version holds exactly the files sent

setLive.description: make this existing version live (no files needed)

name: update_page
title: Change a hosted page
